title: vLLM integration and hybrid routed-expert execution

sources.notes: Live stock versus enabled all-CUDA adapter contract: exact greedy token/text parity; router set drift is diagnostic rather than a gate.
Live eager harness requiring both OOT replacements and at least one generated output token.

A-B-A graph freshness, completion/reset ordering, CPU int4 comparison, and exact CUDA-plus-B70 addition intent. Current get_b70_poller/register_layer calls have source-visible API drift and require update before this harness is runnable.
CPU GPTQ int4/group128 differential, inactive-tier zero checks, and exact saved CUDA+B70 partial joining.
CPU checks for nibble order, zero point, signed scales, and identity error metrics.
CPU admission, ownership, compaction, dummy-slot masking, buffer geometry, and malformed-bank rejection contract; its fake_vllm_config explicitly does not prove live vLLM APIs.
Read-only legacy NVFP4 and SBINT401 CPU bank access used by host paths and independent numerical oracles; byte-plane parsing is documented but abstracted by the state model.
Opt-in Laguna inference patch that merges compatible NVFP4 gate/up projections, compensates alpha differences, and permanently falls back per module after unsafe layout/runtime failure.
Opt-in Laguna auxiliary-boundary capture, CPU chunk accumulation/truncation, non-finite zeroing, shared flattened view, and atomic SpecForge record publication.
Historical local-only seam. It counts runner calls, while issue/take deliberately raise; live hybrid dispatch does not pass through this class.

Primary integration behavior: construction/setup, all-CUDA versus decode/prefill choice, compact remote masking, eager reference/sync/async and graph paths, multi-lane summation, CPU partial addition, stable eager output, and fail-closed unsafe prefill/error observation. Numerical kernels and detailed doorbell/residency mechanisms are abstracted.
Requalification and required-container seam around stock vLLM composition; calls legacy begin_all_cuda and carries optional diagnostics/static-output helpers.
CPU algebra comparison for merged gate/up packed values, block scales, and unequal-alpha correction; does not exercise CUDA custom ops.
CPU/filesystem contract for request parsing, truncation, record layout, shared storage, idempotence, atomic part cleanup, and ordinary-request ignore.
Live eager all-CUDA versus split hybrid CUDA-reference comparison; hybrid marker plus exact greedy tokens are required.
Referenced registration dependency outside the assigned ownership inventory: owns gate ordering, process-global patches, preemptive hook timing, paired OOT registration, and conflict rejection.

assumptions: vLLM calls the registered HybridMoERunner and modular HybridRoutedExperts entrypoints; source notes that a total forward_monolithic bypass cannot be caught inside forward_modular.
Placement supplies exclusive CUDA, per-B70, and optional CPU ownership; its policy construction is specified by the placement branch.
Doorbell/poller modules eventually release each issued lane on success or native failure; release is modeled separately from result validity.
Tensor payloads are abstract contribution identities. Floating-point equivalence is delegated to CPU numerical comparisons and live harnesses, not inferred from the Reyu state machine.
Prefill/residency modules preserve the same global-expert identity while selecting dispatch, DRAM streaming, Marlin, or B12x; their engine internals are owned by the prefill branch.
Filesystem os.replace provides the external atomic-publication behavior used by hidden capture.
No assigned harness, test, build, formatter, linter, GPU workload, or server workload was executed during authoring.

implementation_checks.description: CPU-executable check of GPTQ K-major nibble order, zero point 8, negative scales, and exact identity metrics.
CPU-executable algebraic differential: merged gate/up weights and alpha rescaling must match two separate matmuls.
CPU/filesystem executable contract for accumulation, truncation, dtypes/shapes, loss mask, shared storage, duplicate idempotence, and atomic publication.
CPU-executable ownership/remap check that remote IDs become valid dummy slot zero only with exactly zero CUDA weight.
Offline CPU-versus-captured-provider differential for all-B70 and straddled routes plus exact stored partial-sum and inactive-tier-zero checks.
After reconciling its drifted poller API, compare alternating captured graph outputs with independent CPU int4 references and reject stale-buffer selection.
Source inspection check: verify the legacy provider seam still raises and is not mistaken for the live hybrid transport.
Source inspection check: every offloaded mask is excluded from CUDA weights before corresponding B70/CPU partial addition, and every graph issue precedes local CUDA while takes follow it.
